channel.title: Explained SCP in need of review
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Explained SCP in need of review" - A Foundation agent investigating an anomalous village discovers that there's actually no anomaly... Or is there?

item.title: Explained SCP in need of review
item.content:encoded:
I wrote this a while ago as part of the Exquisite Corpse contest, and I'd like to try my luck at it again.
It's about an agent investigating an anomalous village inhabited by clones of the same individual, only to find himself absorbed by the phenomenon. It relies heavily on hiding the twist until the very end, so that's what I mostly need help with (whether or not the twist is obvious).

Here you go, in the "Exquisite Corpse" tab. Thanks in advance!
